name: fmp_economic_calendar
description:
Macroeconomic release calendar from Financial Modeling Prep (FMP, /stable/economic-calendar): GDP, jobs, CPI, central bank meetings, PMI and other events by country, with previous, estimate and actual values.
Returns {events}: FMP's list of economic events.
Inputs (* required): from_date (YYYY-MM-DD), to_date (YYYY-MM-DD); both optional.
For company events use fmp_earnings_calendar; for US yields fmp_treasury_rates.
Example: {"from_date": "2025-10-01", "to_date": "2025-10-07"}
